event_text: Earliest use Todoist has found of the stolen credential for its version control system
The attacker obtains an administrative credential for Todoist's employee sign-in system
The attacker exports and downloads account records with email addresses and old password hashes
Todoist begins investigating an unexpected administrator account flagged by its security monitoring
Todoist disables its Outlook email add-in
Todoist publishes its notice about the incident
notes: The notice's update log gives 16:11 UTC; its own timeline says 17:11 UTC.
